WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
account_order_differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM account_order_counts
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM account_order_differences
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10 WITH TIES;
